provenance: Spec-authored with msgpack-python (scripts/gen-governance-vectors.py); every runtime re-encodes `message` and must match messagePackHex. Commitment hashes follow vote-api.md 'Commitment'.

invalid.name: cast_commit_carries_a_ballot
invalid.why: a commit names exactly the commitment; a ballot beside it would put content on the wire before the reveal

invalid.name: cast_reveal_carries_a_commitment
invalid.why: a reveal names exactly the ballot

invalid.name: ballot_reason_leading_space
invalid.why: the contract refuses untrimmed text; it never trims for the sender, so the hashed bytes are the sent bytes

invalid.name: ballot_candidate_trailing_nbsp
invalid.why: NO-BREAK SPACE is White_Space; trimming is judged by the same list as write-receipt Required fields

invalid.name: ballot_salt_31_hex
invalid.why: salt is 32 to 128 lowercase hex characters

invalid.name: ballot_persona_with_space
invalid.why: persona is printable ASCII without space, at most 64

invalid.name: receipt_echoes_candidate
invalid.why: sealed casts never echo ballot content; the receipt is closed

invalid.name: receipt_echoes_salt
invalid.why: the salt never comes back before close

invalid.name: receipt_time_without_zone
invalid.why: instants are UTC with a Z

invalid.name: motion_one_candidate
invalid.why: a motion has two or more candidates

invalid.name: motion_phase_unknown
invalid.why: phase is Commit, Reveal or Closed

invalid.name: motion_leaks_tally
invalid.why: mid-vote a client sees no tallies; the document is closed

refusals.name: unauthenticated
refusals.trigger: no bearer, or one Heimdall does not know

refusals.name: forbidden
refusals.trigger: authenticated, not an Active member, or a Mind key used on a motion route it may not call

refusals.name: not_found
refusals.trigger: unknown motion id, a standard (non-sealed) motion id, or reveal without a prior commit

refusals.name: wrong_phase
refusals.trigger: commit outside Commit, reveal outside Reveal

message.error: The commit window is not open.

refusals.name: contended
refusals.trigger: reveal raced the close fence; send it again

message.error: The reveal is contended; send it again.

refusals.name: invalid
refusals.trigger: body fails vote-api.schema.json or an in-document rule (untrimmed candidate or reason, candidate not in the motion, round or motionId mismatch, persona wrong for the credential)

message.error: The cast does not satisfy gamecult.vote.cast.v0.

refusals.name: commitment_mismatch
refusals.trigger: reveal whose canonical bytes do not hash to the stored commitment

message.error: The ballot does not match the stored commitment.

refusals.name: rate_limited
refusals.trigger: more than the per-credential cast rate; Retry-After mirrors retryAfterSeconds
